reviewFocus.en: Review included-credit allocation, overage policy and metered budgets together. Confirm current API and UI availability before changing controls; this source review does not measure actual savings.
reviewFocus.ko: 포함 크레딧 배분·초과 사용 정책·종량제 예산을 함께 검토할 것을 제안합니다. 통제 설정을 바꾸기 전 현재 API·화면 제공 여부를 확인해야 하며 실제 절감액을 측정한 원고가 아닙니다.

en.title: Copilot credit pools: included usage and additional spending

claims.text: GitHub announced cost-center AI credit pools for Copilot Business and Enterprise on Enterprise Cloud. At announcement time, configuration was available through the REST API, while settings-UI management was still planned.

evidence.quote: This is available through the REST API today. Management in the cost center settings UI is coming soon.
This is available for Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise on GitHub Enterprise Cloud

claims.text: The pool cap limits a cost center’s draw from enterprise-wide included credits; a cost-center budget governs metered charges after the included pool is exhausted. These controls cover different spending phases and can be combined.

evidence.quote: An AI credit pool is separate from a cost center budget.
A cost center budget governs the metered phase, capping charges after the pool is exhausted.

claims.text: GitHub calculates the pool limit from assigned licenses. At the cap, enterprises can block further included usage or allow additional spend when overages are permitted, so the pool is not automatically a hard cap on all charges.

evidence.quote: GitHub calculates the pool limit automatically from the licenses assigned to that cost center
block further included usage or let it continue as additional spend if your enterprise allows overages.

evidence.quote: This is available through the REST API today. Management in the cost center settings UI is coming soon.
